page.overview:
Who is Boomerang?

Boomerang is a member of the in Tales of the TMNT. He takes his orders from and .

After escapes from Mechazoid 02, he climbs up out of the river and coughs up a small turtle. He then hears a young woman ask if the turtle just coughed up another turtle and when Raph looks up, he sees a pair of young humans staring at him. The young man, Boomerang, turns to his fellow who are in a nearby delivery truck and says that the big turtle coughed up a little turtle. Raph stands up and starts to threaten them, but then passes out. The young woman, , and Boomerang drag Raph over to their truck.

When Raph wakes again, he is in the back of the truck, tied up with an extension cord. He asks if the three nearby Purple Dragons, one of whom is Boomerang, actually tied him with an extension cord. Boomerang takes a few steps towards him and makes a snide comment, to which Raph responds by easily snapping the cord. Boomerang immediately pulls a Boomerang from his pocket and steps back, holding the object out like a weapon. Raph asks if they want to tell him who they are before he cracks their skulls, or after. Boomerang answers that they are the Purple Dragons and they run Brooklyn. The girl behind him, Pipe, corrects him to say more like the the Sunset Park, Bay Ridge area. Another member, Mini Golf, starts to argue the point, until Boomerang stops them and tells Raph they run 7th Avenue between 40th and 42nd Street.
